## 3. Every feature: window, evidence

Active when any window contains the version. `[from, until)` is half-open; `exact` matches one declared build by id; `all declared` means the true boundary lies beyond the newest declared build. The evidence column is where the research stops and the inference starts.

| Feature | Domain | Window | Evidence |

## 4. How to read a row

To change what a version does, change the **feature window** (one line in `Feature`), the **version's own data** (`legacy/LegacyCatalog`: spawn set, drops, food heals, generation revisions), or the **implementation** of the mechanic. Do not add a version check anywhere else: `ArchitectureLintTest` fails on one. Adding a version is described in [ADDING_VERSIONS.md](ADDING_VERSIONS.md); adding a behaviour is in [ADDING_FEATURES.md](ADDING_FEATURES.md).
